subject: Barcelona reportedly enquire about Bayern's Jonathan Tah to partner Cubarsí
title: Barça want Bayern's centre-back

lines.vo: Barcelona want a centre-back from Bayern. Good luck with that.
Deco reportedly wants an experienced defender to play next to Pau Cubarsí. Basically, a grown-up for the back line.
Sky Sports Deutschland says Barcelona asked about Jonathan Tah, who is thirty. Bayern have little interest in selling. Asking is free, at least.
His contract runs to twenty twenty-nine, and he is not considering a move. So that is a no, with extra paperwork.
Levi Colwill is also linked, but he is reportedly near a new deal. Two names on the list, zero yeses. Good luck with that, again.
